name: uptown-assets
description: Uptown Assets: Claude Code plugins for this project: session roles, and a button that lists every finished listing video.

plugins.name: session-role
plugins.description: Give each session a Role picked from a dropdown above the chat box: local (.claude/roles) or global (~/.claude/roles) job descriptions with an edit fence, tool limits and a live subagent indicator.

plugins.name: video-list
plugins.description: A button above the chat box that lists every finished listing video (listings/*/output) in a pane, with open and Finder buttons.
